scope_note: The Mokka case is evaluated in declared configuration semantics. Configuration literals are not asserted to be universal scheduler-inclusive wall-clock bounds.

sources.source: Kubernetes Pod Lifecycle - termination of Pods
sources.supports: termination grace begins before PreStop; PreStop precedes TERM; a short one-off extension may be requested if PreStop is still running when grace expires
30-s primary termination-grace setting, 10-s native PreStop Sleep declaration, 5-s shutdown timeout, and context-bounded HTTP shutdown implementation
120-s default shutdown.grace-period, two fixed sleeps, and an intervening wait until all active tasks complete with no finite upper bound stated on that page

gracefulShutdown.gracePeriodSeconds default 120 s; chart default worker.terminationGracePeriodSeconds 30 s; and a chart-side check that fails rendering unless worker.terminationGracePeriodSeconds is at least twice the configured grace period when graceful shutdown is enabled
